programme.title: The Cabin in the Woods
programme.desc: When five college friends (Kristen Connolly, Chris Hemsworth, Anna Hutchison, Fran Kranz, Jesse Williams) arrive at a remote forest cabin for a little vacation, little do they expect the horrors that await them. One by one, the youths fall victim to backwoods zombies, but there is another factor at play. Two scientists (Richard Jenkins, Bradley Whitford) are manipulating the ghoulish goings-on, but even as the body count rises, there is yet more at work than meets the eye.

rating.system: Saskatchewan Film and Video Classification Board

programme.title: House on Haunted Hill
programme.desc: A millionaire with theatrical tendencies, Stephen Price (Geoffrey Rush) invites a number of people to stay in a vast creepy building that used to be an insane asylum. Stephen, accompanied by his bitter wife, Evelyn (Famke Janssen), offers a million dollars to anyone who can stay the whole night without leaving out of fear. When Stephen and Evelyn become trapped with their guests, they quickly realize that the house really is haunted -- and the spirits dwelling within are very angry.

programme.title: House of Wax
programme.desc: A gang of college friends, including Wade (Jared Padalecki) and his girlfriend, Carly (Elisha Cuthbert), are en route to a school football game when they wind up with a flat tire in a ghost town. They are forced to seek help in the only place that's open: the local wax museum. Once inside the spooky and seemingly abandoned building, they find the works on display are not quite what they seem -- and the group soon discovers it's being hunted by the insane twin brothers who run the museum.

rating.system: Saskatchewan Film and Video Classification Board

programme.title: Thirteen Ghosts
programme.desc: A state-of-the-art remake of the classic William Castle horror film about a family that inherits a spectacular old house from an eccentric uncle. There's just one problem: the house seems to have a dangerous agenda all its own. Trapped in their new home by strangely shifting walls, the family encounters powerful and vengeful entities that threaten to annihilate anyone in their path.

rating.system: Saskatchewan Film and Video Classification Board

programme.title: Ghost Ship
programme.desc: In a remote region of the Bering Sea, a boat salvage crew discovers the eerie remains of a grand passenger liner thought lost for more than 40 years. But once onboard the eerie, cavernous ship, the crew of the Arctic Warrior discovers that the decaying vessel is anything but deserted. It's home to something more deadly and horrific than anything they've encountered in all their years at sea.

rating.system: Saskatchewan Film and Video Classification Board

programme.title: Trick 'r Treat
programme.desc: Interwoven stories demonstrate that some traditions are best not forgotten as the residents (Anna Paquin, Brian Cox, Dylan Baker) of a small town face real ghosts and goblins on Halloween. Tales of terror reveal the consequences of extinguishing a Jack-o-Lantern before midnight and a grumpy hermit's encounter with a sinister trick-or-treater.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: Jeepers Creepers 2
programme.desc: After his son is set upon by a scarecrow that seems to have come alive, farmer Jack Taggart Sr. (Ray Wise) and his son, Jack Taggart Jr. (Luke Edwards), go looking for an explanation. Meanwhile, a bus carrying high-school students breaks down nearby, and a creature known as the Creeper (Jonathan Breck) starts a killing spree. The elder Taggart soon realizes that the killings and the attack on his son are connected, and, after alerting the community to be on guard, he aims to pummel the Creeper.

rating.system: Saskatchewan Film and Video Classification Board

programme.title: Night of the Living Dead
programme.desc: For reasons unknown, the recently deceased are rising from the grave as flesh-hungry zombies. Fleeing from the undead horde, a small group of survivors, including Barbara (Patricia Tallman), Ben (Tony Todd) and Harry (Tom Towles), sequester themselves in a remote farmhouse. With the zombies outside the house multiplying, tensions flare, as the group argues over the best way to escape their increasingly dire situation before they are overrun completely.

programme.title: Family Feud Favorites
programme.desc: "Family Feud" has seen some crazy moments over the years, so buckle up as we revisit these fan favorites. programme.title: The Price Is Right
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." The two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. A trio of models presents the prizes.

programme.title: Super Password
programme.desc: Like the 1960s version, two contestants, each teamed with a celebrity partner, compete in a word-association game. One player tries to guess a word based on clues offered by his or her partner. The game is timed, and if the clue-giver inadvertently says part of the word, a buzzer sounds and that round is lost. The team with the most points at the end of the round gets to go on to a fast-paced bonus round called Cashword.

programme.title: Card Sharks
programme.desc: This show from legendary Mark Goodson-Bill Todman Productions features two contestants trying to predict answers to survey questions for the opportunity to play a game with oversized playing cards for a chance to win cash. One contestant guesses how many people (out of 100) gave a certain answer to a question and the other contestant then guesses if the number is higher or lower than the opponent's guess. The winning contestant then faces a row of cards and must determine if each succeeding card is higher or lower than the one that precedes it. The contestant who wins two out of three games wins the match and plays the bonus round, called Money Cards. The Money Cards round is similar to the card game in the main game but with three levels of cards instead of one row. The contestant is given $200 at the beginning of Money Cards and wagers any or all of that money when guessing if the cards will be higher or lower than the previous one. A perfect round could earn the contestant $28,800.

programme.title: Card Sharks
programme.desc: This show from legendary Mark Goodson-Bill Todman Productions features two contestants trying to predict answers to survey questions for the opportunity to play a game with oversized playing cards for a chance to win cash. One contestant guesses how many people (out of 100) gave a certain answer to a question and the other contestant then guesses if the number is higher or lower than the opponent's guess. The winning contestant then faces a row of cards and must determine if each succeeding card is higher or lower than the one that precedes it. The contestant who wins two out of three games wins the match and plays the bonus round, called Money Cards. The Money Cards round is similar to the card game in the main game but with three levels of cards instead of one row. The contestant is given $200 at the beginning of Money Cards and wagers any or all of that money when guessing if the cards will be higher or lower than the previous one. A perfect round could earn the contestant $28,800.

programme.title: The Price Is Right
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." The two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. A trio of models presents the prizes.

Secretly working with U.S. Marshall Vince Larkin (John Cusack), Poe tries to foil Grissom's plan.

The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new midnight show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live "SportsCenter" morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms.

programme.title: Live: Get Up
programme.desc: ESPN's morning show features host Mike Greenberg with a rotating and diverse group of analysts opining about and analyzing the latest news from the world of sports. The two-hour, personality-driven show originates from Hudson Square in Lower Manhattan, a modern media hub for ESPN and The Walt Disney Company's New York-based teams. Greenberg, aka "Greeny," is formerly one-half of ESPN Radio's longtime "Mike & Mike" morning show.

programme.title: Live: First Take
programme.desc: Stephen A. Smith hosts this weekday morning sports debate show. Smith provides his expert takes on the day's trending sports topics and under-the-radar news. They're regularly joined by veteran analysts and the top guests in sports and entertainment.

programme.title: Live: The Pat McAfee Show
programme.desc: Former NFL punter Pat McAfee brings his humor and candor to the microphone to highlight the day's top stories.

programme.title: Live: Big Day With Peter Schrager
programme.desc: Peter Schrager's daily show will feature rotating panelists focusing heavily on the NFL while also providing coverage of other major sports stories.

programme.title: Live: NBA Today
programme.desc: In-depth, comprehensive daily coverage of all aspects of the NBA from expert analysts.

programme.title: NFL Live
programme.desc: Host Laura Rutledge takes the helm of this weekday show featuring the likes of Marcus Spears, Dan Orlovsky, Mina Kimes, and Adam Schefter. The "NFL Live" crew entertains fans while offering all the latest news and analysis from across the NFL.

Ce qui les oblige à se justifier devant la directrice de l'école, madame Prudence, qui, bien entendu, ne les croit jamais. Aventure, humour et surprise sont au programme de cette série d'animation françai

programme.title: Okoo-koo
programme.desc: Okoo-koo – Saison 5 : encore plus proche des enfants, encore plus inspirante ! Cette année, l'émission se rapproche encore davantage de son public avec \" Okoo, c'est chez vous \.

programme.title: MLB Central
programme.desc: MLB Network's first-ever regular-season morning show features hosts Robert Flores, Mark DeRosa and Lauren Shehadi reporting from Studio 21, named in honor of Hall of Famer and humanitarian Roberto Clemente. Updates and context on the latest news, extensive on-field highlights, and long-form conversations with guests, celebrities and insiders from around baseball are presented each weekday morning. Flores joined the network in 2016 as a host/reporter, DeRosa offers a unique outlook as a former player, and Shehadi honed crisp interviewing skills during three years of hosting MLB Network's "The Rundown.".

programme.title: Live: Intentional Talk
programme.desc: MLB Network's first-ever talk show is an open forum that features some talk and a lot of banter each weekday for host Kevin Millar, who discusses with special guests what's hot and what's not in and around the national pastime. He also runs out of the baseline at times by welcoming guests from the worlds of entertainment and pop culture to talk about trending topics in those arenas. Millar gained fame as a member of the 2004 world champion Boston Red Sox, and since he retired from the diamond his knowledge of the game and warm, affable personality have vaulted him into a lengthy career in the media.

programme.desc: Agorà ha un obiettivo ambizioso: vuole raccontare l'Italia attraverso la politica. Agorà vuole ripristinare il corretto contatto tra la politica e le persone. Vuole proporre e favorire un dialogo sui temi concreti, partendo dall'attualità, dalla vita di tutti i giorni, vietando il facile ricorso al politichese per eludere il contenuto reale dei problemi.

programme.title: Agorà Extra
programme.desc: Agorà Extra ha un obiettivo ambizioso: vuole raccontare l'Italia attraverso la politica. Agorà vuole ripristinare il corretto contatto tra la politica e le persone.

programme.title: Elisir
programme.desc: Il programma di salute e benessere della mattina di Rai3. La trasmissione vuole essere vicina al pubblico aiutandolo ad orientarsi in un panorama ogni giorno più ricco di informazioni mediche...

programme.title: Quante storie
programme.desc: Ogni giorno storie, personaggi e temi con l'intento di approfondire alcuni aspetti della complessità che ci circonda. Dall'arte alla letteratura, dalla musica alla storia recente, dalla filosofia alla politica, Giorgio Zanchini e i suoi ospiti offrono spunti di riflessione per comprendere le mille facce di un paese meraviglioso e contraddittorio.

programme.title: Passato e presente
programme.desc: Un accademico di fama e tre giovani studenti che aspirano ad essere gli storici del futuro ne discutono con Paolo Mieli. La narrazione avverrà attraverso il confronto tra i loro diversipunti di vista. Il rigore della ricerca e la suggestione delle immagini per un grand e racconto tra passato e presente.

programme.title: TGR Leonardo
programme.desc: Il programma che unisce l'attenzione all'attualità del quotidiano con il rigore della documentazione e dell'approfondimento scientifico. Tra gli argomanti trattati ci sono non solo scienza e tecnologia, ma anche salute, ambiente, economia, società.

programme.title: TGR Piazza Affari
programme.desc: Il notiziario economico quotidiano. Ultime notizie di economia e sull'andamento della borsa. Programma di Ines Maggiolinia a cura della redazione economica della TGR Lombardia.

programme.title: TG3 L.I.S.
programme.desc: Notiziario di attualità italiane e mondiali. Tutti gli eventi più importanti che hanno avuto luogo negli ultimi 24 ore spiegati con il linguaggio dei segni.

programme.title: Aspettando Geo
programme.desc: Rubrica quotidiana dedicata alla natura, all'ambiente, agli animali e alla scienza. In onda in diretta con documentari, filmati redazionali e approfondimenti in studio.

programme.title: Geo
programme.desc: Geo, con Sveva Sagramola ed Emanuele Biggi. Documentari, notizie e curiosità sugli animali, progetti innovativi e stili di vita sostenibili. Un viaggio quotidiano tra le bellezze e le criticità del nostro Pianeta per capire come affrontare il cambiamento climatico e vivere in armonia con il mondo che ci circonda.

programme.title: Monk
programme.desc: Attraktiver Deal für Monk (Tony Shalhoub): Jurastudentin Julie verspricht, ihm wieder eine Stelle im Polizeidienst zu verschaffen, wenn er ihre vermisste Oma findet. Sie wurde von zwei Maskierten aus ihrer Wohnung entführt...\n\nFamiliäre Bande wurden auch außerhalb der Geschichte gepflegt: In der Folge hat Tony Shalhoubs Bruder Michael eine Nebenrolle als Ron Abrash bekommen.

programme.title: Blue Bloods – Crime Scene New York
programme.desc: Infos zur Staffel:\n\nBevor die Polizeiserie mit der 14. Staffel zu Ende geht, können Fans noch mal erleben, was sie so fesselnd macht. Und aktuelle Probleme wie etwa Fentanyl-Missbrauch werden thematisiert.

Dodgeball: A True Underdog Story
programme.desc: Average Joe's Gym and its owner, Peter La Fleur (Vince Vaughn), are both down on their luck. A fancy competing gym called Globo-Gym, run by the maniacal health nut White Goodman (Ben Stiller), is about to put Average Joe's out of business unless Peter can raise $50,000 to keep his mortgage. To save the gym, Peter and a ragtag group of Average Joe's members and employees enter a dodgeball contest with a big cash prize. In response, White forms his own Globo-Gym team to rout the competition.

programme.title: Terminator 2: Judgment Day
programme.desc: In this sequel set eleven years after "The Terminator," young John Connor (Edward Furlong), the key to civilization's victory over a future robot uprising, is the target of the shape-shifting T-1000 (Robert Patrick), a Terminator sent from the future to kill him. Another Terminator, the revamped T-800 (Arnold Schwarzenegger), has been sent back to protect the boy. As John and his mother (Linda Hamilton) go on the run with the T-800, the boy forms an unexpected bond with the robot.

Hum Hai Rahi Pyar Ke
programme.desc: Rahul looks after his spoilt nephews, Sunny and Vicky, and niece, Munni. When they go to a funfair, they meet Vyjayanti, who has run away from home, and decide to shelter her without Rahul's consent. Release Year: 1993 Director: Mahesh Bhatt.

programme.title: Housefull
programme.desc: Aarush is the unluckiest man in the world. He believes his bad luck will disappear if he finds true love, guiding his hopeful, romantic quest. Release Year: 2010 Director: Sajid Khan.

programme.title: Gustaakh Ishq
programme.desc: Seeking to master perfect poetry, Nawabuddin seeks guidance from retired Urdu poet Aziz, but things get wonderfully complicated when he falls for his mentor's beautiful daughter.

programme.title: Jolly LLB 2
programme.desc: A blunt, compassionate, struggling lawyer moves from Kanpur to Lucknow to pursue his dream of making it big-time. Release Year: 2017 Director: Subhash Kapoor.

programme.title: Teri Baaton Mein Aisa Uljha Jiya
programme.desc: Aryan cannot find his ideal partner. He meets Sifra on a trip to the USA and falls in love with her, only to discover later that it is an impossible love affair. Release Year: 2024 Director: Amit Joshi,Aradhana Sah Awards: 23rd Zee Cine Awards: Kriti Sanon for SIFRA.

programme.title: Akira
programme.desc: An action thriller in which a self-reliant college student takes on corrupt police officers single-handedly to prove her innocence.

programme.title: Atithi Tum Kab Jaoge
programme.desc: A tired working couple hosts an uninvited guest who refuses to depart, suddenly turning their routine evening into a tense, humorous test of hospitality and boundaries. Release Year: 2010 Director: Ashwni Dhir Awards: 2011 Winner Apsara Award- Best Comic Actor- Paresh Rawal, 2011 Winner Bollywood BusineSS Award- Most Profitable Actor- Ajay Devgn.

programme.title: Kaagaz 2
programme.desc: The Struggles of a common man whose right to life is infringed upon by protests and rallies. Release Year: 2024 Director: V.K. Prakash.

programme.title: Vijay The Master
programme.desc: A professor with a drinking problem goes to a school for young people. He argues with a bad person who makes the students do crimes.

programme.title: Dil Dosti Etc
programme.desc: Two college boys arrogance leads them to challenge each other to prove their efficiencies. It stars Shreyas Talpade, Imaad Shah, Nikita Anand, Smriti Mishra and Ishita Sharma. Release Year: 2007 Director: Manish Tiwary.

programme.title: Noorie
programme.desc: Yusuf and Noorie are set to get married but after her father's sudden death, the wedding is postponed. While work takes Yusuf out of town, Noorie is left to fend for herself from many evils. Release Year: 1979 Director: Manmohan Krishna.

programme.title: Kahin Pyaar Na Ho Jaaye
programme.desc: Prem starts drinking as all the girls he falls in love with want to marry 'a rich boy from the US'. Will he marry the girl of his dreams? Release Year: 2000 Director: K. Muralimohana Rao.

programme.title: Dum Laga Ke Haisha
programme.desc: Prem, a school dropout, hesitantly marries an educated but overweight girl, Sandhya. However, the two come closer when they take part in a race, which involves Prem carrying Sandhya on his back. Release Year: 2015 Director: Sharat Katariya.

programme.title: Hichki
programme.desc: Naina, a teacher with Tourette Syndrome, gets her dream job. She faces challenging students and uses her weakness as strength to help them succeed and reach their potential. Release Year: 2018 Director: Siddharth P. Malhotra Awards: 2018 Winner IFF Award- Best ActreSS- Rani Mukerji.

programme.title: Sultan
programme.desc: Sultan Ali Khan, a former wrestler, quits after his son's death. Years later, he returns to the sport, seeking prize money and redemption, determined to reclaim his lost respect.

programme.title: Fan
programme.desc: Gaurav's world revolves around the superstar Aryan Khanna. What happens when his passion turns into a dangerous obsession that crosses the fine line? The Hard Word
programme.desc: Out of prison after serving time for armed robbery, brothers Dale (Guy Pearce), Mal (Damien Richardson) and Shane (Joel Edgerton) are set for a bank heist planned by their underhanded lawyer, Frank (Robert Taylor). But after pocketing his share of the cash, Frank, who's bedding Dale's wife (Rachel Griffiths), arranges to have them incarcerated again. Though he understands what his attorney is up to, Dale and his brothers agree to pull off a final robbery if Frank can get them freed once more.

programme.title: Happy Endings
programme.desc: Filmmaker Nicky (Jesse Bradford) offers to track down the son that Mamie (Lisa Kudrow) gave up for adoption nearly two decades before. programme.title: The Legend of Catclaws Mountain
programme.desc: Mindy adopts Angel, a high-spirited pony that according to legend will lead its owner to gold hidden in the nearby mountains. When Angel is kidnapped by a mad treasure hunter, Mindy and her school friends head into the hills to rescue the pony and hunt for the lost gold.

programme.title: House of D
programme.desc: In the present, artist Tom Warshaw recalls his traumatic coming of age. As a 13-year-old growing up in New York City in 1973, Tom hangs out with Pappass, a mentally disabled man. With Tom's mother battling depression after the death of her husband, the young boy is left to his own devices. When Tom develops a crush on schoolmate Melissa, Pappass feels abandoned and begins behaving erratically.

programme.title: Big Eyes
programme.desc: In the late 1950s and early '60s, artist Walter Keane achieves unbelievable fame and success with portraits of saucer-eyed waifs. However, no one realizes that his wife, Margaret, is the real painter behind the brush. Although Margaret is horrified to learn that Walter is passing off her work as his own, she is too meek to protest too loudly. It isn't until the Keanes' marriage comes to an end and a lawsuit follows that the truth finally comes to light.

rating.system: Saskatchewan Film and Video Classification Board

programme.title: Bandslam
programme.desc: A gifted singer/songwriter, Charlotte hires Will Burton, a new guy in town, to manage her fledgling rock band. She wants one thing from him: to help her win a contest against her ex-boyfriend in an upcoming battle of the bands. Charlotte's band comes together and seems to have a real shot at victory, while Will and dynamic guitarist Sa5m begin to make some beautiful music of their own.

Szlakiem miejsc niezwykłych - pomniki historii
programme.desc: Program prezentuje najciekawsze pomniki i zabytki polskiej kultury.

programme.title: Komisarz Alex
programme.desc: Mimo orzeczenia prokuratora o naturalnej śmierci profesora historii komisarz Alex i jego zespół podejmują śledztwo. Krok po kroku odkrywają, że mężczyzna padł ofiarą zabójstwa.

programme.title: Ranczo
programme.desc: Lucy rodzi córeczkę. Na wieść o tym Kusy mdleje. Boi się, że nie podoła roli ojca. Wybiera dla małej imię Dorotka. W nocy czuwa w fotelu przy łóżeczku. Do wójta przyjeżdża córka z chłopakiem. Klaudia od niedawna studiuje w Lublinie.

programme.title: Polacy światu
programme.desc: Ludwik Kmicic- Skrzyński urodził się w Odessie 26 sierpnia 1893 roku. Dzieciństwo spędził na terenach dzisiejszej Gruzji. Do gimnazjum uczęszczał w Tbilisi, a po jego ukończeniu wyjechał do Belgii, gdzie rozpoczął studia na Wydziale Chemii.

programme.title: Pan Mama
programme.desc: Sylwester spotyka dawnego znajomego. Nikodem prowadzi idealne życie: egzotyczne podróże, luksusowe apartamenty, niekończące się sukcesy. Sylwester zaczyna się zastanawiać, czy rodzina była najlepszym wyborem w jego życiu.

programme.title: Barwy szczęścia
programme.desc: Broda nieustannie rozmyśla o Jance, na którą niespodziewanie natrafia w sklepie Grzelaków. Na wieść o wieczornej zabawie ostatkowej w remizie, mężczyzna wyrusza do Brzezin, aby zdobyć jej względy własnymi wypiekami.

programme.title: Niezwykłe miejsca
programme.desc: Miejsca znane i mniej znane, często zapomniane i takie, które nie są niedostępne dla wszystkich. Miejsca skrywające wiele tajemnic, owiane legendą, miejsca o bogatej historii. W odcinku: Muzeum Praga.

programme.title: Stulecie Winnych
programme.desc: Ania i Mania uczą się w gimnazjum Platerek w Warszawie. Z Brwinowa dochodzą niepokojące wieści o zdrowiu Antoniego. Po konsultacji w warszawskiej klinice, lekarz stwierdza u Winnego chorobę otępienną. Paweł wyznaje Ani miłość.

programme.title: Ojciec Mateusz
programme.desc: Do Sandomierza przyjeżdża aktorka Maria Brodzka z mężem reżyserem, by wystawić spektakl według "Anny Kareniny" Tołstoja. Tytułową rolę gra Maria. Podczas prób dochodzi do wypadku. Policja podejrzewa, że ktoś chce pozbyć się Marii.

programme.title: Notacje
programme.desc: Jadwiga Lesiecka urodziła się w 1921 roku w Warszawie. Od 1945 roku mieszkała i tworzyła w Sopocie. Odbyła liczne podróże artystyczne m. in.: do Francji, Włoch, Hiszpanii, Wielkiej Brytanii, Belgii, Holandii. Wiele wystaw indywidualnych i zbiorowych w kraju i za granicą przyniosło jej uznanie zarówno wśród krytyków jak i miłośników sztuki. Jadwiga Lesiecka zmarła w lipcu 2015 roku.

programme.title: Maria Konopnicka
programme.desc: Jej teksty budziły kontrowersje, wywoływały polemiki, bywały krytykowane, ale w swoich czasach cieszyła się popularnością. Pisała wiersze i poematy, nowele, szkice, teksty publicystyczno - reportażowe, prace krytycznoliterackie.

programme.title: Pan Mama
programme.desc: Trzy wywiadówki jednego dnia? Sylwester wie, że nie da rady, więc zatrudnia zastępców. Miras i Patrycja wkraczają do akcji, by reprezentować dzieci na zebraniach. Szybko okazuje się, że to, co miało być formalnością, zamienia się w festiwal absurdów.

programme.title: Polacy na ratunek Żydom
programme.desc: Historia Agaty i Władysława Wielebów z miejscowości Grudki, zamordowanych przez Niemców za pomoc biednej Żydówce. W czasie okupacji Wielebowie udzielili nieznanej kobiecie wsparcia żywnościowego. 23 września w kościele parafialnym w Gilowie na pograniczu gmin Turobin i Goraj odbyła się Msza święta w intencji zamordowanych. Po niej uczestnicy uroczystości dotarli do miejsca śmierci Wielebów, gdzie

programme.title: Wojenne dziewczyny
programme.desc: Za radą Witka Marysia mówi Dietrichowi, że jest szantażowana przez gestapo. Irka i Ewka idą do domu Brodzkiej po tajemniczą kasetkę, którą zostawił Kamil. Po przygodach zdobywają kasetkę, jest w niej notes z zaszyfrowanymi informacjami.

programme.title: Dom
programme.desc: Basia trafia do szpitala w Otwocku. Choroba zbliża ją do Andrzeja, który okazuje jej czułość i proponuje małżeństwo. Los nie szczędzi mu zmartwień. Będąc w rodzinnym Sierpuchowie, Talar jest świadkiem zabójstwa młodego ZWM - owca.

programme.title: Dobre strony
programme.desc: Cykl programów zrealizowany przez Narodowe Centrum Kultury dotyczący promocji czytelnictwa. Dobrze jest używać literatury aby lepiej czuć, lepiej myśleć i w konsekwencji lepiej żyć. Dwójka artystów rozmawia o inspiracjach literackich.

programme.title: Barwy szczęścia
programme.desc: Broda nieustannie rozmyśla o Jance, na którą niespodziewanie natrafia w sklepie Grzelaków. Na wieść o wieczornej zabawie ostatkowej w remizie, mężczyzna wyrusza do Brzezin, aby zdobyć jej względy własnymi wypiekami.

programme.title: Przyrodnik na tropie
programme.desc: "Przyrodnik na tropie" to program przyrodniczy, w którym prowadzący - Łukasz Bożycki - porusza różne aspekty życia zwierząt w kontekście ich wzajemnych powiązań i oddziaływań.

programme.title: Okrasa łamie przepisy
programme.desc: Propozycje Karola: "wrap" schabowy z sałatą i ogórkami w orientalnym sosie;"wrap" z wędzonym pstrągiem, boczniakami, cebulą i sosem z fasoli;"wrap" inspirowany bitkami z kaszą, z paseczkami wołowiny, marchewką, cebulką i kaszą gryczaną.

programme.title: Niezwykłe miejsca
programme.desc: Miejsca znane i mniej znane, często zapomniane i takie, które nie są niedostępne dla wszystkich. Miejsca skrywające wiele tajemnic, owiane legendą, miejsca o bogatej historii. W odcinku: Muzeum Praga.

programme.title: Stulecie Winnych
programme.desc: Ania i Mania uczą się w gimnazjum Platerek w Warszawie. Z Brwinowa dochodzą niepokojące wieści o zdrowiu Antoniego. Po konsultacji w warszawskiej klinice, lekarz stwierdza u Winnego chorobę otępienną. Paweł wyznaje Ani miłość.

programme.title: Stawka większa niż życie
programme.desc: Hrabia Edwin Wąsowski z polskiego ruchu oporu uchodzi za Austriaka. Jest właścicielem majątku, wydaje przyjęcia, na których bywa wielu niemieckich generałów i dygnitarzy. Niemcy odkrywają u niego skrytkę z materiałami szpiegowskimi.

programme.title: Lena na Bałkanach
programme.desc: Lena na Bałkanach to seria podróżnicza, nie mająca wiele wspólnego z typowym przewodnikiem turystycznym. Jak opowiadać o Bałkanach to trzeba opowiedzieć o lokalnej muzyce, która odzwierciedla ten zwariowany tygiel kulturowy. To połączenie folku, punku, jazzu czy hip - hopu. Kto nie słuchał najsłynniejszego zespołu Gorana Bregovica czy No Smoking Orchestra? Lena odwiedzi jeden z bałkańskich zespołó

programme.title: Przez pamięć i zapomnienie
programme.desc: Podróż przez polskie miasta i miasteczka - niegdyś tętniące życiem ośrodki społeczności żydowskiej - inspirowana książką Mordechaja Canina "Wśród ruin i popiołów".

programme.title: Barwy szczęścia
programme.desc: Marcin bezskutecznie nakłania Renatę do powrotu do ośrodka leczenia uzależnień. Kobieta wypiera swój problem i potajemnie zdobywa kolejne leki, a na widok partnera w towarzystwie koleżanki z pracy reaguje wybuchem zazdrości.

programme.title: 23. Festiwal Kultury Żydowskiej Warszawa Singera 2026
programme.desc: Reportaż pokaże najciekawsze wydarzenia tegorocznej edycji. A o tym jak zmienia się Festiwal Warszawa Singera, dlaczego stał się przestrzenią międzykulturowego dialogu, co można odkryć w kulturze żydowskiej.

programme.title: Nad rozlewiskiem
programme.desc: Konrad zamieszkał z Małgosią nad rozlewiskiem. Pomaga w prowadzeniu pensjonatu. Marysia składa pozew o rozwód. Potem jedzie nad rozlewisko, by zorganizować wyjazd integracyjny. Spotyka Krzysztofa. Wakacyjne uczucie wciąż jest żywe.

programme.title: Nad rozlewiskiem
programme.desc: Umiera babcia Romana. Sławek przylatuje z Kanady na jej pogrzeb. Wkrótce wyjeżdża jednak z powrotem, ku niezadowoleniu Pauli, która chciałaby mieć chłopaka przy sobie. Piernacki rozmawia z Ewą o ślubie.

programme.title: Rozmowy (nie)wygodne
programme.desc: Inspirujące rozmowy Mariusza Szczygła z wybitnymi osobowościami świata kultury i sztuki. Prowokujące pytania, wymagające nieszablonowych odpowiedzi i odkrywania swojej osobowości. Wywiady odbywać się będą we "Wrzenie Świata" - miejscu spotkań bohemy intelektualnej Warszawy. Gość: Ewa Szykulska, aktorka.

programme.title: Polscy szpiedzy
programme.desc: Pułkownik Wojciech Martynowicz. Rozmowa z byłym szpiegiem, który przez lata działał na Bliskim Wschodzie - w samym sercu konfliktów, gdzie jeden błąd mógł kosztować życie. Kim był? Co widział?

programme.title: Pan Mama
programme.desc: Sylwester spotyka dawnego znajomego. Nikodem prowadzi idealne życie: egzotyczne podróże, luksusowe apartamenty, niekończące się sukcesy. Sylwester zaczyna się zastanawiać, czy rodzina była najlepszym wyborem w jego życiu.

programme.title: The Renaissance of Asian Wild Cats:2
programme.desc: 世界40種貓科動物，遍布在地球百分之七十四的陸地，貓科動物是生態系的關鍵物種，保育貓科動物，就等於保育整個生態系統，因為貓科動物是生態系最好的管家。亞洲，是地球上貓科動物最豐富的土地，全球的貓科復興運動，以亞洲為起點，探討亞洲貓科動物的現在與未來。

programme.title: Mr. Lucky
programme.desc: Joe Adams (Cary Grant) is as clever as they come. Certain that he'll be called up during World War II, Joe nabs the draft papers of a man who's been freed from service and leverages his position into a potentially lucrative scam. The captain of a commercial ship, Joe cons war volunteer Dorothy Bryant (Laraine Day) into believing that he's planning a fund drive for the troops. In fact, he's got something more devious in mind. But as Joe rethinks things, he finds his ruse is already in motion.

programme.title: Bride by Mistake
programme.desc: The staggeringly wealthy Norah Hunter (Laraine Day), a shipyard owner, too often finds herself the romantic target of gold-digging men. To attract a suitor whose main interest is not money, she changes places with her secretary, Sylvia Lockwood (Marsha Hunt), and assumes the role of a young working woman. However, she then falls for recuperating fighter pilot Anthony Travis (Alan Marshal), who, in turn, is madly in love with Sylvia -- or, perhaps, with the millions he thinks she has.

programme.title: The Locket
programme.desc: Flashbacks show why a psychiatrist (Brian Aherne) warned a man not to marry his ex-wife (Laraine Day).

programme.title: Woman on Pier 13
programme.desc: Communists blackmail a San Francisco shipper (Robert Ryan) and recruit his wife's (Laraine Day) brother (John Agar) with a blonde.

programme.title: MGM Parade Show
programme.desc: The concept allows the viewer to see the inner workings of a movie studio and featured interviews with MGM stars and explanations of how movies were made; the format changed to show edited versions of MGM films.

programme.title: All That Heaven Allows
programme.desc: Predicated on a May-December romance. The difference here is that the woman, attractive widow Cary Scott (Jane Wyman), is considerably older than the man, handsome gardener-landscaper Ron Kirby (Rock Hudson). Throwing conventional behavior to the winds and facing social ostracism, Cary pursues her romance with Ron, who is unjustly perceived as a fortune-hunter by Cary's friends and family -- especially her priggish brother Ned (William Reynolds).

programme.title: Leave Her to Heaven
programme.desc: While on a train, writer Richard Harland (Cornel Wilde) strikes up a relationship with the gorgeous Ellen Berent (Gene Tierney). Ellen quickly becomes obsessed with Richard and abandons her fiancé, Russell Quinton (Vincent Price), to be with him. The couple rushes into marriage, with both of them caught up in romance and Richard intrigued by Ellen's intensity. Only after settling into marriage, however, does Richard realize that she is psychotically jealous and highly unstable.

programme.title: The Trouble With Harry
programme.desc: When a local man's corpse appears on a nearby hillside, no one is quite sure what happened to him. Many of the town's residents secretly wonder if they are responsible, including the man's ex-wife, Jennifer (Shirley MacLaine), and Capt. Albert Wiles (Edmund Gwenn), a retired seaman who was hunting in the woods where the body was found. As the no-nonsense sheriff (Royal Dano) gets involved and local artist Sam Marlowe (John Forsythe) offers his help, the community slowly unravels the mystery.

programme.title: The Cobweb
programme.desc: At a psychiatric clinic for the elite, Dr. Stewart McIver (Richard Widmark) wants to institute a policy of self-governance among his patients. To further his goals, Dr. McIver proposes that residents collaborate to design and make new drapes for the clinic library. Though it seems inconsequential, trouble ensues when the clinic patients become locked in a power struggle with the equally unbalanced staff, including activities director Meg Rinehart (Lauren Bacall).

programme.title: The Daytrippers
programme.desc: Eliza D'Amico's seemingly idyllic marriage to Louis changes dramatically when she discovers what she believes to be a love letter to him from someone else. Going home to her family for comfort, Eliza sets out with her mother, father, sister and her sister's boyfriend in the family car to track down and confront Louis. Always one step behind him, the family learns a lot about each other in the process.

programme.title: Sweet November
programme.desc: Sara (Sandy Dennis), a free-spirited single woman living in Brooklyn, invites a new man to stay with her every month. For Sara, this is an opportunity to expose a man to new things, but it's also a way to make sure she will always be remembered by someone. Her latest boarder is Charlie (Anthony Newley), an uptight British businessman. Things, however, don't go as planned, and the two fall in love. Despite this, Charlie cannot stay any longer than his allotted month.

programme.title: Outward Bound
programme.desc: A group of strangers finds themselves aboard an unmanned ship, surrounded by fog and uncertain of their destination. As they attempt to make sense of their situation, the group of passengers, which include a man (Leslie Howard) and his long-lost mother (Beryl Mercer), discover that all they have in common is that each is dead and en route to their final judgment by Thompson (Dudley Digges). However, two desperate lovers, Henry (Douglas Fairbanks Jr.) and Ann (Helen Chandler), may be different.

programme.title: Smilin' Through
programme.desc: On the day of his wedding, Sir John Carteret's fiancée, Moonyeen, is killed by a jealous rival named Jeremy, leaving him emotionally devastated. Carteret spends three decades in seclusion, mostly communing with the spirit of Moonyeen, until he learns that her niece, Kathleen (also Shearer), has become an orphan. He adopts and raises the child as his own but is alarmed when, as a young woman, she falls in love with the son of Moonyeen's murderer.

programme.title: Romeo and Juliet
programme.desc: In this classic Hollywood take on Shakespeare's tragic romance, dashing young Romeo (Leslie Howard), a Montague, falls in love with the radiant Juliet (Norma Shearer), a member of the Capulet family, the Montagues' sworn enemies. Willing to defy the families' feud, the two secretly get married, however their happy day turns tragic when Juliet's cousin, Tybalt (Basil Rathbone) kills Romeo's best friend, Mercutio (John Barrymore), prompting Romeo to retaliate.

programme.title: The Petrified Forest
programme.desc: In this film adaptation of the Robert E. Sherwood play, a drifter, a waitress and a notorious gangster cross paths in the Petrified Forest region of Arizona. Alan (Leslie Howard), a destitute writer, goes into the diner where Gabrielle (Bette Davis) works. Gabrielle dreams of studying art, and she and Alan connect as they talk about Europe and she tells him her ambitions. But gangster Duke Mantee (Humphrey Bogart) shows up and takes the customers hostage.

programme.title: It's Love I'm After
programme.desc: Despite constant bickering on and offstage, Shakespearean actors Basil Underwood (Leslie Howard) and Joyce Arden (Bette Davis) intend to marry after their closing performance in "Romeo and Juliet." But following the show, debutante Marcia West (Olivia de Havilland), smitten by Basil's interpretation of Romeo, visits backstage to declare him the perfect man for her. Basil is initially flattered by her attentions, which enrages Joyce -- until they both find Marcia more than they can handle.

programme.title: Pygmalion
programme.desc: When linguistics professor Henry Higgins (Leslie Howard) boasts that he can pass off Cockney flower girl Eliza Doolittle (Wendy Hiller) as a princess with only six months' training, Colonel George Pickering (Scott Sunderland) takes him up on the bet. Eliza moves into Higgins's home and begins her rigorous training after the professor comes to a financial agreement with her dustman father, Alfred (Wilfrid Lawson). But the plucky young woman is not the only one undergoing a transformation.

programme.title: 49th Parallel
programme.desc: In the early days of World War II, a German U-boat is sunk in Canada's Hudson Bay. Hoping to evade capture, a small band of German soldiers led by commanding officer Lieutenant Hirth (Eric Portman) attempts to cross the border into the United States, which has not yet entered the war and is officially neutral. Along the way, the German soldiers encounter brave men such as French-Canadian fur trapper Johnnie (Laurence Olivier) and soldier Andy Brock (Raymond Massey).

programme.title: Monty Python and the Holy Grail
programme.desc: A comedic send-up of the grim circumstances of the Middle Ages as told through the story of King Arthur and framed by a modern-day murder investigation. When the mythical king of the Britons leads his knights on a quest for the Holy Grail, they face a wide array of horrors, including a persistent Black Knight, a three-headed giant, a cadre of shrubbery-challenged knights, the perilous Castle Anthrax, a killer rabbit, a house of virgins, and a handful of rude Frenchmen.

programme.title: Monty Python's Life of Brian
programme.desc: Brian Cohen (Graham Chapman) is an average young Jewish man, but through a series of ridiculous events, he gains a reputation as the Messiah. When he's not dodging his followers or being scolded by his shrill mother (Terry Jones), the hapless Brian has to contend with the pompous Pontius Pilate (Michael Palin) and acronym-obsessed members of a separatist movement. Rife with Monty Python's signature absurdity, the tale finds Brian's life paralleling Biblical lore, albeit with many more laughs.

programme.title: Monty Python's The Meaning of Life
programme.desc: The stages of life are told through multiple sketches and songs by the British comedy troupe. The seven parts of life cover birth, growing up, war, middle age, organ transplants, old age and death. Not all stages are singular: "Part I: The Miracle of Birth" is from the perspective of an ignored woman in labor, and of a Roman Catholic couple with too many children, and "Part VII: Death" encompasses a funeral and heaven. Added are three unrelated skits placed in the beginning, middle and end.

programme.title: Yentl
programme.desc: Rebbe Mendel is a single father who teaches the Talmud, a sacred text of Judaism, to the boys of his small Polish town. Behind closed doors, he also instructs his daughter, Yentl, despite the fact that girls are forbidden to study religious scripture. When Yentl's father dies, she still has a strong desire to learn about her faith -- so she disguises herself as a male, enrolls in a religious school, and unexpectedly finds love along the way.

programme.title: What's Up, Doc?
programme.desc: Two researchers have come to San Francisco to compete for a research grant in music. The man seems a bit distracted, and that was before he met a strange woman who has devoted her life to confusing and embarrassing him. At the same time a woman has her jewels stolen and a government whistle blower arrives with his stolen top secret papers.

programme.title: Elmer the Great
programme.desc: Elmer Kane (Joe E. Brown) is an arrogant but gullible baseball player who must leave his Gentryville sweetheart, Nellie (Patricia Ellis), to join the Chicago Cubs. Once on board, his teammates take advantage of his gullibility with practical jokes, and the management hides the letters that come from Nellie. When she comes to Chicago to see him play the World Series, a series of misunderstandings and bad judgments threatens to ruin both his love life and career.

programme.title: Random Harvest
programme.desc: A veteran of World War I, Charles Rainier (Ronald Colman) has lost all memory of his life before the war. Left to wander, Rainier meets a showgirl, Paula (Greer Garson), with whom he falls in love. Rainier and Paula are soon happily married, but when Rainier travels out of town, a car hits him -- erasing the memories of his life with Paula, but restoring those of his life before the war. While he returns to his previous life, Paula tries to find a way to be reunited with her husband.

programme.title: Anthony Adverse
programme.desc: Based on the novel by Hervey Allen, this expansive drama follows the many adventures of the eponymous hero (Fredric March). Abandoned at a convent by his heartless nobleman father, Don Luis (Claude Rains), Anthony is later mentored by his kind grandfather, John Bonnyfeather (Edmund Gwenn), and falls for the beautiful Angela Giuseppe (Olivia de Havilland). When circumstances separate Anthony and Angela and he embarks on a long journey, he must find his way back to her, no matter what the cost.

programme.title: They Won't Forget
programme.desc: The town of Flodden is in an uproar when a pretty student is found dead on Confederate Memorial Day, but District Attorney Griffin (Claude Rains) sees it as an opportunity. Thinking the case could propel him into the U.S. Senate, he begins an extensive smear campaign against the girl's teacher, Robert Hale (Edward Norris), an outsider who hails from New York. Despite only circumstantial evidence, Hale is convicted, and locals threaten vigilante justice if he isn't executed.

programme.title: I Am a Fugitive From a Chain Gang
programme.desc: Jaded World War I veteran James Allen (Paul Muni) dreams of creating a new life, but those dreams are shattered when he is implicated in a robbery and sentenced to 10 years on a chain gang. The brutal prison conditions compel James to break out and flee to Chicago, where he assumes a new identity and, over time, becomes a successful businessman. His freedom and happiness are threatened, however, when his scheming landlady (Glenda Farrell) discovers his secret and threatens to blackmail him.

programme.title: Little Caesar
programme.desc: An aspiring small-town criminal, Caesar "Rico" Bandello (Edward G. Robinson) relocates to Chicago to hit the big time, accompanied by his buddy, Joe Massara (Douglas Fairbanks Jr.). While Rico makes a name for himself in the underworld, Joe decides to leave the life of crime and ventures into show business, where he meets the lovely dancer Olga (Glenda Farrell). Though Rico and Joe try to honor their friendship, eventually their choices take them down dramatically different paths.

programme.title: Thirty Seconds Over Tokyo
programme.desc: During World War II, Lt. Col. James H. Doolittle (Spencer Tracy) leads the U.S. Air Force in a bombing mission over Japan. Doolittle and his men stage a successful attack on Tokyo, but most pilots run out of fuel while returning from the raid. Many are forced to land on Japanese soil, but Capt. Ted Lawson (Van Johnson), who has a pregnant wife at home, crash-lands in the sea off the coast of China. Stranded, Lawson must heroically endure a series of harrowing challenges to make it back home.

Infos zur Reihe:

In einer Woche treten jeweils fünf Wirte gegeneinander an. Die Konkurrenten bewerten dabei natürlich das Essen, aber auch den Service, die Atmosphäre, die Sauberkeit, das Gesamtkonzept und das nicht zu definierende „gewisse Etwas“! programme.title: Roadkill
programme.desc: Mike and David buy each other their worst automotive nightmares and put them to the test against Steve in a showdown; Finnegan rides high, Freiburger works through some "cosmetic" damage and Dulcich rampages through fire.

programme.title: Roadkill
programme.desc: The T-Bizzle is an '86 Thunderbird powered by a 302 V8, topped with a 6-71 blower and welded gears; Freiburger and Finnegan take it across the frozen tundra of the northern U.S., on a classic road trip with plenty of fail.

programme.title: Roadkill
programme.desc: Freiburger and Finnegan take a look at Roadkill's Top Project Cars.

programme.title: Roadkill
programme.desc: Freiburger and Finnegan clean out wheels that have been stashed in the garage for far too long by slapping them on a neglected '66 Dodge D100 Utiline truck; they hit the road on a quest to find the perfect 440 for it.

programme.title: Roadkill
programme.desc: The guys scrounge their parts piles and come up with impressive results.

programme.title: Roadkill
programme.desc: Freiburger and Dulcich settle who has the better cheap 4x4.

programme.title: Roadkill
programme.desc: The guys have a build off and race like no other; Tony transforms a shell of an '85 Monte Carlo into a beast, while Finnegan makes Newbern's Nova run with ramp truck parts; it's three days of wrenching, two tracks and one unbelievable race.

programme.title: Roadkill
programme.desc: Mike Finnegan and David Newbern rescue a mint '67 Pontiac Firebird that has been stowed in a barn for almost two decades; the guys battle old parts, downpours and other issues in order to get this old drag car racing down the track once again.

programme.title: Roadkill
programme.desc: Freiburger and Dulcich hit the road in the '68 Wreck Runner, a four-speed, 383ci clone made from the scraps of a '68 Road Runner and a '68 Satellite; it only has a few little issues; they hit the road to sort 'em out.

programme.title: Roadkill
programme.desc: Finnegan and Newbern take the barn-find '67 Firebird on an 800-mile road trip to race Freiburger and Dulcich in the Crusher Camaro.

programme.title: Roadkill
programme.desc: Freiburger and Finnegan race Dulcich and Newbern in a dirt-track shootout.

programme.title: Faster With Newbern And Cotten
programme.desc: The guys try their hand at no-prep drag racing against Lyle Barnett and his turbocharged 1,500-hp Beer Money Mustang.

programme.title: Faster With Newbern And Cotten
programme.desc: For years, Pigpen, the junkyard rescued 1950 GMC truck, has sat dormant; the guys awaken a monster by donating the chassis of their own legendary 1985 S-15 in a body swap for the ages, then take on Randy Pobst at Atlanta Motor Speedway.

programme.title: Faster With Newbern And Cotten
programme.desc: Everyone wants their car to be better, faster, stronger, but a difference is hard to make on a budget; David Newbern and Mike Cotten may not have all the answers, but they're willing to give it a run by mixing affordable upgrades with sweat equity.

programme.title: Faster With Newbern And Cotten
programme.desc: The guys uncover a cop car racing series around the Ford Crown Victoria P71 Police Interceptor; with a handful of bolt-on upgrades, they turn their former police auction find into a road race ripper around Willow Springs.

programme.title: Faster With Newbern And Cotten
programme.desc: The guys take on off-road Baja legend Cameron Steele on a brutal desert off-road course with a Baja Bug; they may be outmatched by Cameron's unlimited racing rig, but the addition of a 350 V-8 to their Bug closes a big gap.

programme.title: Faster With Newbern And Cotten
programme.desc: The guys take their V-8-powered Pontiac Fiero-based Lamborghini Countach kit car known as the Scamborghini and give it a 6-foot lift to take on an insane wheelie-popping mud truck through what's known as a bounty hole.

programme.title: Faster With Newbern And Cotten
programme.desc: The guys take a big-block '57 Bel Air to compete in the autocross at Cruisin' the Coast in Miss.; with a complete overhaul of the suspension in the event's parking lot, the guys find out how much lap time they can shave in a weekend.

programme.title: Die Goldbergs

programme.title: Garfield
